findings.description: subprocess.call is used; subprocess.run is recommended for better control and error handling. The current call is not vulnerable to command injection because arguments are passed as a list without shell=True.

The string 'ghp_XXXXXXXXXXXX' in get_version_string may be misidentified as a GitHub token by naive secret scanners, but it is not a real secret. If possible, use a clearer placeholder to reduce false positives.
